about.title: Here's a little about
about.description: I'm a passionate fullstack developer based in Grenoble, currently studying engineering at IMT Nord Europe while doing an apprenticeship. I love mixing creativity and logic to build elegant, user-friendly digital experiences. When I'm not coding or dreaming up new projects, you'll find me exploring the outdoors, jamming to music, or enjoying a good coffee. I'm always open and motivated to take on new external projects — so feel free to reach out!

reviews.subtitle: Discover authentic testimonials from clients who trusted my expertise for their web projects

list.name: Timon Guillotin
list.comment: Téo brought Ciel Avenue to life with incredible attention to detail. His technical skills and creative vision helped us build a platform that truly simplifies real estate. Working with him was an absolute pleasure!

list.name: Axel Elias
list.comment: Couverto started as my idea, and Téo helped me turn it into reality. We share this project 50/50, and his technical expertise combined with his dedication made all the difference. A true partner in every sense!

list.name: Mayeul Deries
list.comment: Téo helped me build an exceptional website to track job applications. His professionalism and attention to detail are remarkable. I highly recommend!

list.name: Gabriel Halus
list.comment: I had the pleasure of working with Téo on the Let’sgo Lego, Paperlive, and Ahcanfut projects. It was a great experience every time. Téo naturally brings innovative ideas and always finds relevant solutions to challenges. It is a genuine pleasure collaborating with him.

list.name: Félix Picon
list.comment: Téo’s boilerplate saved me hours of setup. His guidance was sharp, clear, and very useful. It was great to collaborate with someone so precise and passionate.

work_hours.question: What are your working hours?
work_hours.answer: I’m generally available Monday to Friday but I adapt to my clients’ needs.

contact.question: How can I contact you?
contact.answer: You can reach me by email at teo.villet2@gmail.com or via the contact form on my website.

long_term_projects.question: Are you available for long-term projects?
long_term_projects.answer: Yes, I’m open to long-term collaborations and a variety of projects.

work_process.question: What is your work process?
work_process.answer: My process includes a consultation phase to understand your needs, followed by design, development, and thorough testing before delivery.

post_delivery_support.question: Do you offer support after project delivery?
post_delivery_support.answer: Yes, I offer support for 30 to 60 days after delivery, depending on the project type.

technologies.question: What types of technologies do you use?
technologies.answer: I use modern technologies like React, Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB to build high-performance web applications.

custom_quote.question: How can I request a custom quote?
custom_quote.answer: You can request a custom quote by contacting me directly via the form on my website or by email.

pricing_design.question: How much for a custom design?
pricing_design.answer: The Custom Design package starts at €800. It includes modern mockups (Figma), mobile/desktop responsive design, and professional font/color selection.

pricing_showcase.question: What are your rates for a showcase website?
pricing_showcase.answer: Showcase websites start from €1200. Perfect for presenting your activity with a fast, modern, and SEO-optimized site.

pricing_features.question: How much for a website with features?
pricing_features.answer: Prices start at €2500. This includes features like reviews, contact forms, booking systems, and a secure personal dashboard.

pricing_complete.question: What is the price for a complete website?
pricing_complete.answer: For a complete website with database and custom advanced features, prices start from €4800.

services_offered.question: What types of services do you offer?
services_offered.answer: I offer UI/UX design, showcase websites, feature-rich sites, and custom full-stack web applications.
